$comment: The toolchain every build and every recorded figure assumes. Metal has no container image to pin, as Charlotte pinned emsdk's, so the versions are pinned here instead and tools/check_toolchain.py compares them with the machine's at configure time; a mismatch stops the build. To move to a new Xcode, change this file in its own commit and rerun the tests: a new Metal compiler can change what the shaders compute.
